name: cco-chat-webview
description: The cost-routed chat webview. Structure follows Cline and Roo Code (Apache-2.0): a React app, react-markdown with remark-gfm and rehype-highlight for replies, react-virtuoso for the message list, unified diffs parsed with `diff` and rendered like VS Code's diff editor. Bundled with the extension's esbuild (scripts/build-webview.mjs).
